verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of DNS templates, guided setup, or one-click connect flows for external hosts or site platforms. The only related items say registered domains automatically use Cloudflare nameservers and that DNSSEC is one-click, which are adjacent features, not host-connection templates. Connecting a domain to a hosting platform is a fair question for a registrar, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a founder, connecting the domain to where my site lives is one guided step — templates or one-click connect for the major hosts and platforms
